brand.preservation: Copied unchanged; retain proportions, contain fit, circular rounding, and no shrinking.

authStoryBackground.description: The user-pinned sign-in foundation is white (#ffffff) across the page, story, form region, and decorative background, retaining the desktop left/right split. A static maroon spiral is rendered as inline SVG: (64) ruled strips follow a sampled twist and share a fabric gradient, with fine translucent white seams. The SVG fills its region with a (720 × 1100) viewBox and `xMidYMid slice` cropping. A white readability veil preserves dark-ink headings and muted body copy; the brand remains maroon. The decoration has no motion or animation loop, is pointer-inert and hidden from assistive technology, and uses no external assets. The compact mobile white brand header remains the mobile composition. Login locally uses white ground, pale rules (#e5e2df), and a muted maroon focus outline (#8c4658); authenticated workspace tokens retain their warm surfaces.

applicationReceipts.description: Application forms add a labeled confirmation-email field using the existing control style, with help text explaining the receipt destination and acceptance of an officer’s personal email. Receipt status is a normal paragraph (13px), with (16px 0 22px) margins and wrapping for long addresses; written messages distinguish queued, sent, and failed delivery while confirming that a failed email leaves the application saved. SEC review offers the existing secondary-button style to retry eligible unsent receipts, disabled while busy. These additions retain the ordinary form and record hierarchy.
applicationReceipts.fieldHelp: We’ll send a receipt here when you submit. An officer’s personal email is fine.
applicationReceipts.retryVisibility: Receipt exists, status is not SENT, and confirmation attempts are below 5.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Main action with maroon hover and explicit disabled treatment.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:11px 17px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:7px; background:var(--maroon,#500000); color:#fff8f3; font:650 12px/1.4 var(--sans,"DM Sans Variable",sans-serif); min-height:42px; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease; } .ds-button:hover:not(:disabled) { background:#712727; box-shadow:0 3px 8px #50000016; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ds-focus,#a75a39); outline-offset:4px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-button { transition:none; } }

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Supporting action with a ruled paper surface.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:11px 17px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:7px; background:var(--maroon,#500000); color:#fff8f3; font:650 12px/1.4 var(--sans,"DM Sans Variable",sans-serif); min-height:42px; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease; } .ds-button:hover:not(:disabled) { background:#712727; box-shadow:0 3px 8px #50000016; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ds-focus,#a75a39); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-secondary { background:var(--paper,#fff); color:var(--ink,#292623); border-color:var(--line,#e1ded7); } .ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background:var(--tint,#eee8df); box-shadow:none; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-button { transition:none; } }

components.name: Labeled field
components.description: Persistent label with a white bordered control and mobile-readable type.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:7px; color:var(--ink,#292623); font:600 12px/1.6 var(--sans,"DM Sans Variable",sans-serif); } .ds-input { padding:11px 12px; min-height:43px; border:1px solid #c9c4ba; border-radius:6px; background:#fff; color:var(--ink,#292623); font:400 13px/1.6 var(--sans,"DM Sans Variable",sans-serif); caret-color:var(--maroon,#500000); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#716b62; } .ds-input:disabled { background:#f6f4ef; color:#686056; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ds-focus,#a75a39); outline-offset:4px; } @media(max-width:760px) { .ds-input { font-size:16px; } }

components.name: Workspace navigation
components.description: Maroon navigation with a warm active row; the application supplies drawer state and focus behavior.
components.css: .ds-nav { padding:18px; background:var(--maroon,#500000); display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:5px; } .ds-nav-item { padding:12px 14px; min-height:46px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:transparent; color:#e5cdc4; font:400 13px/1.6 var(--sans,"DM Sans Variable",sans-serif); text-align:left; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s ease; } .ds-nav-item:not(.ds-active):hover { background:#6b2828; color:#fff; } .ds-active { background:#f3e9dc; color:var(--maroon,#500000); font-weight:650; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ds-focus,#a75a39); outline-offset:4px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {  .ds-nav-item { transition:none; } }

components.name: Positive status pill
components.description: Compact written state reinforced by semantic green.
components.css: .ds-pill { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:5px 9px; border-radius:5px; background:var(--green-bg,#eaf3ed); color:var(--green,#265c43); font:650 10px/1.5 var(--sans,"DM Sans Variable",sans-serif); white-space:nowrap; }

narrative.overview: Warm paper surfaces, deep maroon navigation, calm headings, and ruled records give societies and SEC a shared operating workspace. Readable records, explicit status, and efficient forms set the visual density. The public name is SocietyHub. Use the existing SEC circular logo copied unchanged from Delphi/public/sec_favicon.png; Nexus is an internal name only.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral surfaces anchored by maroon navigation.
Compact, readable records with clear hierarchy and tabular totals.
Restrained motion and explicit interaction states.

rules.name: The Status Rule
rules.body: Color reinforces a written status; it never replaces the status label.

dos: Do use warm paper surfaces and thin rules for operational records.
Do retain labels, category names, and tabular totals when showing status or points.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep closed mobile navigation out of keyboard navigation.
donts: Don't replace written states with color alone.
Don't apply resting shadows to the flat record panels.
Don't substitute an invented mark for the supplied SEC logo.
